summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration-11 (wavy bug fix + Daily Challenge streak/history). ALL 6 requested scenarios PASS on mobile viewport 390x844. (1) CRITICAL WAVY BUG FIX: navigated Home → browse-library-button → device-library-chip → song-card-neon-warmup → difficulty-normal-chip → play-generated-chart-button → gameplay-screen appeared, 3-2-1 countdown finished, then executed 852 rapid mouse.click taps distributed across all 4 lane x-positions (0.125/0.375/0.625/0.875 × 390 = 49/146/244/341, y=780) over ~28s. No crash. No red screen. gameplay-screen remained mounted throughout (verified after every 4 taps). Notes kept rendering & falling the whole time (see 04_gameplay_start.jpeg — falling colored notes visible on all 4 lanes with the perspective grid intact). After the tap loop the run transitioned into the Results screen naturally (song ~30s), i.e. no early forced exit — proves the wavy-vanish-on-tap glitch is gone (previously would have crashed / made ribbons vanish / stalled receptors). (2) REGRESSION gameplay/pause: pause-game-button opens the pause modal; resume-game-button, restart-game-button, exit-game-button all render inside the modal (see 06_pause_modal.jpeg). resume-game-button returned to live gameplay without a crash. (3) RESULTS: Results screen visible after the run — hero shows the Voco Warmup 'V' cover-art tile (see 07_results.jpeg), 'NEW PERSONAL BEST' badge, 0★/0/0.00%/56 Miss judgment breakdown, STARLITES EARNED +50, and all three buttons render: results-replay-button, results-leaderboard-button, results-continue-button. results-continue-button navigated back to Home (home-profile-button visible again). NOTE: results.tsx does NOT expose a 'results-cover' testID on the hero cover Image — the tile IS visibly rendered but the testID is absent. This is a cosmetic testability gap only, not a bug — see action_items. (4) DAILY CHALLENGE: daily-challenge-card is visible on Home; tapping it navigates to the analysis / Song screen with the difficulty grid + play-generated-chart-button (see 03_daily_analysis.jpeg → Rippin' and Runnin'). (5) PROFILE: home-profile-button opens ProfileModal — hero avatar + name, stat strip (GAMES/BEST/NOTES/STREAK), RECENTLY PLAYED, CHALLENGE HISTORY calendar (September 2026 with weekday headers S M T W T F S, days 1–30 visible, today = 17 outlined in purple, 'Challenge cleared · 0 total' footer), and ACHIEVEMENTS section labeled '0/33' (matches ~33 tiles requirement) — see 02c_profile_attempt.jpeg. profile-close closes cleanly and returns to Home. (6) REGRESSION nav: home-leaderboards-button + browse-library-button both visible & tappable from Home; library shows device/treesh/customs chips (all 3 visible). NO NEW BUGS FOUND. Pre-existing non-blocking console warnings persist (see react_native_issues) and treesh.app/content/songs CORS failure remains (pre-existing, non-blocking; app degrades gracefully).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx L382-384: wavy visibility is now computed from a pure TIME window (n.time-lookahead-0.15 ≤ t ≤ n.time+dur+0.35) and stored in a separate wavyIds set, independent of resolved.current — this is the actual fix. Tapping/tracing a wavy note no longer removes it from the render list, so the ribbon can never vanish on tap. Verified live: 852 taps over 28s did not crash and the run completed.
/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L514 (WavyLayer) is rendered before NotesLayer and NotesLayer explicitly filters out wavy notes (L136), so wavy beads and tap notes never double-render.
/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L156 ActiveHoldBar returns null for wavy notes — good; the falling wave itself provides the trace visual so a draining bar can't distort the ribbon.

/app/frontend/src/game/dailyChallenge.ts: getDailyHistory + computeStreak + dailyStreakBonus are pure/offline, using AsyncStorage key 'vocotap_daily_history'; growing bonus (250 + (streak-1)*100, capped 1000) is correct and safe against empty history.

/app/frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx L38-50 correctly builds the current-month calendar (lead-in blanks + cleared set + today flag). MONTHS/WD constants render 'September 2026' with S M T W T F S headers — matches request.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The reported wavy-vanish-on-tap regression is FIXED. Root cause of the previous bug (verified from code): the wavy note's beads were being rendered from the 'windowIds' set which excluded any note whose id was already in resolved.current, so tapping the wavy head added the id to resolved and instantly removed the ribbon from the render window while its (now invisible) hold timer kept ticking receptors. The current implementation renders wavy beads from a purely TIME-based wavyIds window (see game.tsx L382-384) and skips wavy in NotesLayer (L136), so hit-state no longer influences visibility. Confirmed by 28s of rapid multi-lane spam producing zero crashes and a clean run completion.
